_doc: item Profile 5 40x20 (0.0.370.04): 40 x 20 mm, Line 5, natural anodised. Dimensions and section figures are item's product data sheet; the groove is item's table of groove dimensions. It is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (item's x-axis). The drawn outline leaves out the rounds inside the grooves and the lean of the groove faces. The drawn outline comes to a torsion constant of about 8400 mm⁴ where the sheet says 6200: item's own section drawing, solved the same way, comes to 8500, so the sheet's figure is the odd one, and the check says so.
